name: Menethil Statuette
summary: Off the Wetlands coast, the Menethil Statuette lies lost from a shipwreck. The rare silver likeness honors Lordaeron's fallen king.

sections.title: A Rare Relic of Lordaeron
sections.body: King Terenas Menethil II appears in his youth, a long-haired paladin lifting a hammer toward the heavens. He was humble and disliked personal monuments, so few statues or likenesses were made in his honor. The Scourge's fall of Lordaeron destroyed almost all of them. This surviving effigy is extraordinarily valuable to the Alliance.

sections.title: Loss in the Bogs
sections.body: The Blind Princess carried the statuette toward the Alliance harbor of Menethil. Bluegill murlocs attacked the merchant vessel off the marshy coast, scattering its cargo. The statuette became trapped in a half-buried barrel on shore. With Dragonmaw orcs and other local threats nearby, defenders hurried to send the recovered icon south to Stormwind City. There, Highlord Bolvar Fordragon entrusted it to the Cathedral of Light.

faq.q: Who is shown on the statuette?
faq.answer: The statuette depicts King Terenas Menethil II, former ruler of Lordaeron and architect of the original Alliance. He appears as a young paladin, raising a warhammer.
The merchant vessel Blind Princess carried it across the Great Sea. Bluegill murlocs attacked the ship in the Wetlands, and its cargo washed ashore and was buried in the mud.

faq.q: Why are depictions of King Terenas so rare?
aliases: why are there few statues of terenas
faq.answer: King Terenas disliked self-aggrandizing memorials, so few statues of him were made. The Scourge's devastation of Lordaeron destroyed almost all the portraits and figures that remained in the north.

faq.q: Where does the statuette end up?
aliases: where do i take the statuette
faq.answer: After its recovery in the Wetlands, the statuette is brought to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep. He recognizes the Light within the relic and entrusts it to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker at the Cathedral of Light.

angles.text: As a paladin, you see King Terenas as a young warrior of the Light, raising his hammer. His portrait speaks to holy knights who mourn the fallen kingdom.
As an Alliance member, you know Terenas as the unifying leader who founded the Grand Alliance. Any memorial of him that survives is an inspiring treasure in a fractured world.
